hero.title: Trusted Ethiopian fruit & vegetable cooperative since 2002.
hero.desc: Meki Batu Union unites 135 primary cooperatives and 8,089 member farmers in Oromia, Ethiopia. We cultivate and distribute premium, GlobalG.A.P certified fresh produce and licensed seeds worldwide.

bento.title: Export-Grade Ethiopian Produce
bento.desc: Grown in the volcanic soils of the Great Rift Valley under GlobalG.A.P certified standards.

process.title: From Rift Valley Farms to Global Tables
process.desc: A fully traceable 4-stage cold chain connecting 135 primary cooperatives to domestic consumers and international buyers.
process.buyersLink: Learn how to source our produce as a buyer

steps.title: Intake & Calibration
steps.description: Harvested produce arrives from 135 member cooperatives and is immediately inspected, sorted, and calibrated into export and domestic grades.

steps.title: Post-Harvest Precooling
steps.description: Swift pre-cooling removes field heat within hours of harvest, locking in nutritional value, firm texture, and extended post-harvest freshness.

steps.title: Sanitary Washing & QA
steps.description: Produce undergoes sanitized washing, residue testing, and rigorous QA inspection adhering strictly to GlobalG.A.P compliance.

steps.title: Cold Logistics & Export
steps.description: Packed into ventilated export cartons and dispatched via refrigerated transport to 5 Addis retail outlets and international air freight.

resources.title: Modern Agro-Infrastructure
resources.desc: Temperature-controlled facilities, refrigerated transport, and modern irrigation driving high yields and low post-harvest loss.

coldStorage.name: Cold Storage & Warehousing
coldStorage.desc: Multi-chamber temperature-controlled cold rooms and warehouses serving 135 cooperatives.

fleet.name: Refrigerated Transport Fleet
fleet.desc: Insulated cold-chain trucks and farm tractors ensuring farm-gate freshness to final market.

packhouse.name: Central Export Pack House
packhouse.desc: Standardized grading, sanitary washing, and GlobalG.A.P certified export packaging lines.

irrigation.name: Lake Ziway Irrigation Schemes
irrigation.desc: River-fed electric pumping stations and modern drip systems powering year-round cultivation.

testimonials.title: Voices From Our Cooperative Network
testimonials.desc: Hear from member farmers, cooperative leaders, and commercial trade partners across Ethiopia and Europe.

t1.quote: Working with Meki Batu Union has meant consistent quality and reliable export volumes season after season. Their GlobalG.A.P compliance gives our retail buyers total confidence.

t2.quote: The union has helped our 350+ cooperative members access fair minimum pricing, agronomy workshops, and direct cold-chain transport that protects our harvests.

t3.quote: Their Rift Valley tomatoes and green beans set the benchmark for Ethiopian produce exports. Full batch traceability from field to air-freight packing.

t4.quote: Through Meki Batu Union’s capacity building and seed programs, female farmers in our district have doubled their yield and established independent farm revenues.

t5.quote: Their GlobalG.A.P certification gave us total confidence to build a long-term sourcing relationship. Reliable logistics and prompt export documentation.

t6.quote: Access to high-germination hybrid seeds and union mechanization equipment transformed our harvest efficiency. We now export grade-A onions consistently.
